detail.longDescription: I added AI person detection to my home surveillance cameras--with no cloud service, no subscription fees, and everything staying on my own network. A Raspberry Pi, Google Coral USB accelerator, RTSP cameras, Moonfire NVR, and some Python/Perl scripts are enough to build it yourself. https:// salemdata.net/johnpress/?p=1204 # HomeAutomation # SelfHosted # Surveillance
